title: Support & Documentation
description: Get help and learn how to use our platform effectively.

hero.title: How can we help you?
hero.description: Find answers to your questions, learn how to use the platform and contact our support team.

faqs.question: How can I change my password?
faqs.answer: Go to Dashboard > Settings > Password. Enter your current password, then the new password twice to confirm it.

faqs.question: Can I switch my theme to dark mode?
faqs.answer: Yes! Use the moon/sun button in the top right corner of any page to switch between light and dark mode.

faqs.question: How do I manage my tasks?
faqs.answer: Go to Dashboard > Tasks to view, create, edit and delete your tasks. You can mark them as completed by clicking the checkbox.

faqs.question: Where do I configure my notifications?
faqs.answer: In Dashboard > Settings > Notifications you can control which types of notifications you want to receive and how.

faqs.question: How do I contact technical support?
faqs.answer: You can reach us by email at support@boilerplate.com or through live chat during office hours.

faqs.question: Is my data safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use enterprise-grade encryption and follow security best practices to protect your information.
